tags.description: This uphill par 5 is the most generous hole throughout the golf course. Three great shots will warrant low scoring opportunities. A back right to front left sloping green will challenge your green reading abilities.

A challenging par 3 with an expansive green, the largest on the course, protected by two large front bunkers.. A well hit tee shot can get you on the dance floor. Any mishits can result in a 120 foot putt on a sloping green.
